facts.title: Honey-Sweetened Almond Chocolate Chip Granola Bars
ingredients: 1 ¾ cups quick-cooking oats (or old-fashioned oats, pulsed briefly in a food processor or blender to break them up)
⅔ cup mini dark chocolate chips
½ to ¾ teaspoon salt, to taste (decrease if your almond/peanut butter is salted)
1 cup creamy unsalted almond butter or peanut butter
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
